out_items.name: Proper eating, tasting, drinking, or tobacco use

violations.title: Eating, Drinking, or Using Tobacco
violations.observation: Open drinking containers used or stored in a manner that may contaminate food, food contact surfaces or utensils. Observed open employee drink containers at the cookline.
violations.corrective_action: Food employees may have beverages in the kitchen areas as long as they are covered and consumed through a straw and stored in a manner that will prevent contamination to food, equipment, utensils, linens, and single service items. Drinks moved away from cookline and food prep area, EHS discussed utilizing tops for employee drinks.

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: Observed raw shell eggs stored over RTE foods in the 2 Dr prep unit.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. Eggs moved to bottom shelf of pre unit.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, Durable/Smooth Materials
violations.observation: The nonfood-contact surface of the following equipment is not corrosion resistant, nonabsorbent, and/or smooth: Observed cardboard used under cutting board to prevent slipping, observed cardboard used in freezer unit for food item storage, observed tape lining the overhead shelving along the cookline.
violations.corrective_action: Non-food contact surfaces of equipment that are exposed to splash, spillage, or other foods that require frequent cleaning shall be constructed of a corrosion- resistant, nonabsorbent, and smooth material. Cardboard discarded. Please change and clean tape as necessary.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: Observed that the FLOOR TILING under the fryers and along the cookline is not maintained in good repair.
violations.corrective_action: Repair the physical facilities. Poor repair and maintenance compromises the functionality of the physical facilities.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Water Temp
violations.observation: The handwashing sink at COOKLINE was observed with the hot water line disconnected. Sink is observed with leakage from faucet when hot water connection is open.
violations.corrective_action: A handwashing sink shall be equipped to provide water at a temperature of at least 100F through a mixing valve or combination faucet. Manager called for maintenance.

violations.title: Handwashing Cleanser, Availability
violations.observation: Observed that hand soap was not provided at the handwashing sink by the dish machine.
violations.corrective_action: Provide hand soap at each hand sink to allow employees to properly wash their hands. Manager provided soap pump at sink.

violations.title: Food Contact Surfaces Clean to Sight & Touch
violations.observation: Husky containers (non food grade) with scoring inside of container observed for storage of pickled radish.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment food-contact surfaces and utensils shall be clean to the sight and touch. A surface that is soiled cannot be effectively sanitized. EHS discussed container usage with PIC.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Common Name, Working Containers
violations.observation: Working containers of poisonous and toxic materials are not properly labeled with a common name. Observed spray containers of bleach and quaternary sanitizer solution unlabeled.
violations.corrective_action: Label all working containers of poisonous and toxic materials, including cleaners and sanitizers, with a common name to prevent the dangerous misuse of these materials. Employee labeled containers.

violations.title: Food Protection Manager - Accredited Program
violations.observation: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager who has shown proficiency through passing an accredited examination. CFM present has expired certification.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a certified food managers certificate from an accredited program. PIC stated he is working on renewing certification, EHS will follow up with establishment to ensure active CFM is present.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Water Temp
violations.observation: The handwashing sink at main cookline observed with water connection turned off.
violations.corrective_action: A handwashing sink shall be equipped to provide water at a temperature of at least 100F through a mixing valve or combination faucet. -PIC turned on water connection. Hand sink observed at 129F. Please maintain water connections open to handwashing sinks.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Miscellaneous Source Contamination
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were found subject to contamination after receipt and during storage due to the condition as described: Employees observed handling food while wearing powdered gloves.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination that may result from a factor or source not specified under Subparts 3-301 through 3-306. -EHS instructed employees to utilize powder free gloves when directly handling food items with gloved hands. BBQ Chicken & Beer (Inspection Date: 03/25/2025) Page 2 of 3

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Food-Contact Surfaces, Safe Materials
violations.observation: The food-contact surfaces of the following equipment and/or utensils are not safe: Husky utility cases observed for storage of pickled radish in the walk in cooler. Utility cases are not graded for food contact and sanitization.
violations.corrective_action: Materials that are used in the construction of utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment may not allow the migration of deleterious substances or impart colors, odors, or tastes to food and under normal use conditions shall be safe. Discussed container usage with PIC.

violations.title: Plumbing System, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: Plumbing connections under the 3 Compartment Sink piping are leaking.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be maintained in good repair.
